title: A magnesium–copper cell
caption: The half-cell with the more negative E° supplies electrons. Magnesium (−2.37 V) is oxidised and copper ions (+0.34 V) are reduced; electrons flow externally from Mg to Cu, while ions in the salt bridge keep each solution neutral. E°cell = 2.71 V.
alt: A magnesium electrode in magnesium sulfate and a copper electrode in copper sulfate, joined by a wire with a voltmeter reading 2.71 V and a salt bridge.
